scope: Gross voted and non-voted expenditure. Voted data excludes centrally held unallocated funding.

basis.2016-2024: Voted actual expenditure returns / latest non-voted outturn.
basis.2025: Voted provisional outturn estimates / latest non-voted Exchequer outturn.
basis.2026: Revised Estimates for voted expenditure / fiscal forecast projections for non-voted.
basis.2027: Present in source capture but not used in published 2026 library.

note: Raw public chart series preserved for provenance. Website styling and scripts are not reused.
